'''Imdaar''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Dreighton Nebula/Legends|Dreighton Nebula]] with surface features reminiscent of [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]. It was the base of the [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE Phantom]] project, in which the production facility was located on [[Imdaar Alpha]].

==History==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agent [[Ru Murleen]] was transferred there to investigate [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] activity. She met once again her old pupil, [[Rookie One]] in order to capture one of the [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Starship/Legends|ships]]. Together they crossed a swampy jungle and reached an Imperial platform. There, they hijacked [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] ''[[Epsilon Four]]'' in order to board the ''[[Terror]]''.

Also around this time, Imdaar played host to the Galactic Empire's development of the [[V38 assault fighter]] and [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE Phantom]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>

{{Planet-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Although ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' includes an entry for Imdaar, it confuses the planet with its moon, [[Imdaar Alpha]].
